name: atlas
description: AI agent management platform for orchestrating coding agents, tracking tasks, and managing project knowledge
author: Aviran Levi

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @atlas/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "pnpm --filter @atlas/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @atlas/server dev" "wait-on tcp:3100 && pnpm --filter @atlas/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @atlas/shared build && pnpm --filter @atlas/server build && pnpm --filter @atlas/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @atlas/shared build && pnpm --filter @atlas/server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @atlas/client exec tsc --noEmit
